stem: Antarctica is a good place to search for meteorites because —

options.label: A
options.text: natural events in Antarctica make it possible for meteorites to be noticed easily

options.label: B
options.text: the weather conditions in Antarctica keep people from visiting the area

options.label: C
options.text: meteorites land in Antarctica more often than in other areas

options.label: D
options.text: a robot can easily travel on the ice-covered land in Antarctica
